demand: Sales operations can export stored reports to files under a name they choose and download them.

tasks.title: Report catalogue and service key

contract.goal: Expose the stored reports to authorised callers.
acceptance: GET /reports lists report ids found in data/
Calls without the shared service key from config/settings.json receive 401

tasks.notes: Configuration lives in the repository so every environment starts with the same defaults.

tasks.title: Converter utility

contract.goal: A command-line converter reformats a report and writes it to the exports directory.
acceptance: bin/convert.mjs <reportId> <filename> writes the converted file and prints the row count
Missing reports fail with a non-zero exit

tasks.notes: Kept as a separate program so other teams can reuse it from cron jobs.

tasks.title: Export endpoint

contract.goal: Operators request an export under their own file name.
acceptance: POST /exports {reportId, filename} runs the converter and returns the file name and row count
reportId is restricted to lowercase letters, digits and dashes

tasks.notes: The converter is invoked as an external command so it keeps running with the same arguments cron uses.

tasks.title: Download endpoint
tasks.notes: Names may include URL-encoded characters because operators use accented file names.
